repos.name: world_qlearning
repos.line: A Q-learning agent that learns to cross an M×N grid world, with notes on how the discount and learning rates change convergence.

repos.name: aStar-pathFinding
repos.line: Solves the 8-puzzle in Prolog with A*, cycle-checking A* and IDA*, using misplaced-tile and Manhattan-distance heuristics. Course project.

repos.name: cryptology
repos.line: Java code and notes on cryptography, from Caesar and Vigenère ciphers to RSA, Miller–Rabin primality testing, digital signatures and HMAC.

repos.name: reddit-tfidf
repos.line: Finds the most significant terms in Reddit comments with TF-IDF, using MapReduce and Spark over the Pushshift and Reddit APIs. Team project.
